uncited: VoxelTTO training configures the optimization of a voxel-aligned feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) module initialized from a frozen Visual Foundation Model (VFM).
**Data Sampling:** For each dataset, define a minimum and maximum frame gap.
Randomly select an interval between the first and last frame within this range.
**Loss Computation:** At each step, render depth and RGB from the current 3DGS representation.
Compute $L_{depth}$ and $L_{rgb}$ using the defined weights.
- **Memory Complexity:** Not given in the sources.
